says: In next/, the OpenSSH SHA256 fingerprint and ssh-ed25519 key line of a raw Ed25519 key are computed by hand in three places that must agree byte for byte.
proof: transport/Hello.ts:159 builds `SHA256:${Base64.encode(hash).replace(/=+$/, "")}` and lines 165-168 the 51-byte ssh-ed25519 blob; gateway/Gateway.ts:2047 returns the same `SHA256:` string from its own digest; tuval/src/browser/key.ts makeKey and lineFor build both again from the same raw bytes.
cost: A change to one copy (a padding rule, a key type) leaves the door, the gateway and the browser key disagreeing on who a key is, and each new client (the hands key file) would add a fourth copy.
